content.comment_body: I am developing an automatic switching program using [product_name] modules with article numbers [article_no] and [article_no]. The demo program is finalized and running on the controller. However, I noticed an issue: relays Q1–Q4 on the [product_name] module operate correctly in both automatic and manual modes, but relays Q5 and Q6 only respond when the LAN port of the controller is connected to a PC or network switch. This is unexpected—outputs should energize even when the Ethernet cable is disconnected, since I have only configured hardwired digital and analog inputs/outputs in the program, with no network I/O setup. I have attached the program for reference. Could someone explain why this happens and how to fix it?
A PDF file alone is not sufficient. Please upload your program as a ZIP archive. Also, what is the status of the RUN/STOP LEDs on the expansion modules? Are they lit, and if so, what color?

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced unexpected behavior in a controller project, where certain relays only operated when the Ethernet port was connected, despite no network I/O configuration. This led to uncertainty, as the expectation was for all digital outputs to function independently of network connectivity. Troubleshooting is made difficult by a lack of comprehensive program files and unclear status feedback from the modules.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that all outputs should work regardless of Ethernet or network connection, given that only local I/O has been configured. Program logic should determine output activation, not network status.
